description: Return the text with invisible characters, bidi controls, tag characters and control characters removed and unusual spaces turned into normal spaces. By default ZWJ/ZWNJ/VS16 are kept inside emoji sequences, between letters of joining scripts (Arabic, Persian) and after an Indic virama (keep_joiners=true); strict=true removes them everywhere. Optional: map lookalike letters to Latin (lookalikes) and apply NFKC normalisation (nfkc). Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/clean.

keep_joiners.description: Keep ZWJ/ZWNJ/VS16 where they are legitimate: emoji ZWJ sequences and VS16 emoji presentation, between letters of joining scripts (Arabic, Persian), and after an Indic virama. Joiners elsewhere are always removed.

lookalikes.description: Map lookalike letters (e.g. Cyrillic а) to Latin. Changes legitimate non-Latin text too.

nfkc.description: Apply Unicode NFKC first (fullwidth and math letters → plain).

spaces.description: Turn unusual spaces into a normal space.

strict.description: Strict mode: remove every joiner and variation selector, even in emoji and Persian/Indic text (overrides keep_joiners).

text.description: Text to inspect (up to 2000 UTF-16 code units).

name: clean_text
title: Remove hidden Unicode from text
